scientific_limitations: Ordinary replicator dynamics in the infinite-population limit with a fixed finite number of independently coordinated clubs.
Finite-player game establishes payoffs and rankings only; finite stochastic affiliation dynamics are not analyzed.
No taxation, redistribution, cheating, costs, heterogeneous restaurants, correlated club assignments, or extinct-strategy mutations.
Potential equivalent results in 2025 supplementary mathematical notebooks were not accessible for full-text comparison.
title: Exact club-size payoff ordering and winner selection in a multi-club restaurant game
